verdicts.reason: A is the original leaderboard strip shrunk and centred on the new canvas. Nothing is rearranged, and about 60% of the canvas above and below is empty navy, so the type is tiny for the format. B actually restacks the design, with the image band on top and a larger lockup below, but it has visible flaws: the dot grids run over the image band and the '&' glyph, the image band looks stretched and has an awkward slanted end, the 'G' of BEDDING jams against the right-edge dot column with no margin, and the bottom third is dead space.
